title: Trump pushes to rebrand AI as 'super intelligence' in bid to reshape tech narrative
script:
Donald Trump signed a directive to replace the term AI with super intelligence.
The executive order aims to reshape the national tech narrative across federal agencies.
The White House strategy seeks to establish distinct American dominance in advanced technology.
Officials developed the policy to shift public perception away from traditional industry terminology.
Federal departments must update official documents to adopt the new naming convention.
Would you adopt the term super intelligence?
